QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_57

explanation.text: The Logic: Treynor Ratio = (Rp − Rf)/β — uses only systematic (non-diversifiable) risk. The Trap: Std dev = Sharpe; MDD = Calmar; VaR-based ratios exist but are different. Cross-Exam Context: Same formula in X-A/XV. Distributor's Pro-Tip: For well-diversified portfolios, Sharpe ≈ Treynor; for undiversified, prefer Sharpe.
